investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Helgate Go (ride-hailing); Platform: on-premises data center DC-West, server range 172.16.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster helgat-prod (kubeadm); Edge tier: rider-app-bff proxies API calls to backend services using per-upstream timeouts from its configuration file; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
